name: docs.scss
html:
<pre class="docs-code"><code class="lang-scss">// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  docs.scss — view-docs scoped styles: portal layout (header stamp, GL
//  thread backdrop, persistent 3D architecture scene, treeview, editable
//  crumbs, folder grid, file viewer), GitHub-style markdown + parsed-JSON
//  surfaces, the generated folder SVG glyphs, and the @media print +
//  protected copy-guard surface. The content column extends %MAXAREA so
//  the portal respects the project's responsive grid gutters.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../core/sass/base/variables';
@import '../../core/sass/base/mixins';
@import '../../core/sass/base/fonts';
@import '../../core/sass/base/placeholders';

$_B_DOCS: 'docs';

.#{$_B_DOCS} {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
  line-height: 1.6;
  padding-top: to-rem($space-4xl);
  box-sizing: border-box;

  // ── GL thread backdrop + persistent 3D architecture scene ────────────
  // Both are fixed, viewport-sized layers behind the content column —
  // the scene stays mounted on every docs page so folder navigation is
  // always available (orbit/pinch on exposed areas, tap-to-pick).
  &-gl,
  &-scene {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    z-index: 0;
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }

  &-gl {
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  // The scene needs pointer events where the content column leaves it
  // exposed — OrbitControls owns rotate/pinch, taps pick nodes. Ink is
  // the project's turquoise accent *contrast* variant: cyan on dark,
  // deep teal on light — the raw accent is invisible on white.
  &-scene {
    color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
    cursor: grab;

    &:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }
  }

  // CSS fallback: soft drifting gradient band when WebGL is off.
  &-gl-fallback &-gl {
    background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 30%, currentColor 45%, transparent 60%);
    background-size: 300% 300%;
    opacity: 0.04;
    animation: #{$_B_DOCS}-drift 18s linear infinite;
  }

  @keyframes #{$_B_DOCS}-drift {
    from {
      background-position: 0% 0%;
    }
    to {
      background-position: 100% 100%;
    }
  }

  // ── Docs system boot loader ───────────────────────────────────────────
  // Mirrors the space playground's boot overlay — accent glow + blueprint
  // grid backdrop, counter, twin counter-rotating rings, stage message and
  // progress bar — reworded for the docs context. Stays up until the
  // portal's first usable state, then fades out and is removed.

  @keyframes #{$_B_DOCS}-spin-cw {
    to {
      rotate: 360deg;
    }
  }

  @keyframes #{$_B_DOCS}-spin-ccw {
    to {
      rotate: -360deg;
    }
  }

  &-loader {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 50;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    pointer-events: auto;
    overflow: hidden;
    background-color: var(--bg-dark);
    transition:
      opacity 0.8s ease-in-out,
      filter 0.8s ease-in-out;

    &-glow {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(
        circle at center,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 40%, transparent) 0%,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-darkest) 90%, transparent) 60%,
        var(--bg-darkest) 100%
      );
    }

    &-grid {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(
          to right,
          color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 3%, transparent) 1px,
          transparent 1px
        ),
        linear-gradient(
          to bottom,
          color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 3%, transparent) 1px,
          transparent 1px
        );
      background-size: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-4xl);
      -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(
        ellipse 60% 60% at 50% 50%,
        var(--bg-dark) 70%,
        transparent 100%
      );
      mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 60% at 50% 50%, var(--bg-dark) 70%, transparent 100%);
    }

    &-content {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      z-index: 10;
    }

    &-spinner-outer {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
      translate: -50% calc(-50% - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
      width: to-rem($space-8xl);
      height: to-rem($space-8xl);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 10%, transparent);
      border-top-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 80%, transparent);
      border-right-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 30%, transparent);
      border-bottom-color: transparent;
      border-left-color: transparent;
      animation: #{$_B_DOCS}-spin-cw 8s linear infinite;
    }

    &-spinner-inner {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
      translate: -50% calc(-50% - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
      width: to-rem($space-9xl);
      height: to-rem($space-9xl);
      border-radius: var(--radius-round);
      border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 5%, transparent);
      border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 40%, transparent);
      animation: #{$_B_DOCS}-spin-ccw 12s linear infinite;
    }

    &-counter {
      width: to-rem($space-4xl);
      height: to-rem($space-4xl);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
    }

    &-percent {
      @extend .ttl-md;

      font-weight: 300;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 90%, transparent);
    }

    &-sym {
      @extend .txt-sm;

      color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 40%, transparent);
      margin-left: to-rem($space-2xs);
    }

    &-title {
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      letter-spacing: 0.3em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 40%, transparent);
      margin-bottom: to-rem($space-xs);
    }

    &-msg {
      @extend .txt-xs;

      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 80%, transparent);
      height: to-rem($space-lg);
      line-height: to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    &-bar {
      width: to-rem($space-9xl);
      height: 1px;
      background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 10%, transparent);
      margin-top: to-rem($space-md);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;

      &-fill {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        width: 0%;
        background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 80%, transparent);
        transition: width 0.2s ease-out;
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Content column — the project's max-area gutter contract ──────────
  // The containers themselves are pointer-transparent so the fixed scene
  // behind stays draggable wherever no interactive surface covers it;
  // interactive children re-enable hit-testing explicitly.
  &-header,
  &-crumbs,
  &-body,
  &-main,
  &-grid {
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  &-header,
  &-body {
    @extend %MAXAREA;

    z-index: 1;
  }

  &-header {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-md);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-md);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 88%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }

  &-title {
    margin: 0;
    font-weight: 100;
    font-size: to-rem($space-3xl);
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  &-updated {
    margin-left: auto;
    align-self: flex-end;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    opacity: 0.6;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  &-body {
    display: grid;
    // minmax(0,1fr): a bare 1fr track floors at min-content, so min-content
    // payloads (istanbul tables, code <pre>) would blow the column past
    // the viewport. The 0 floor lets the track shrink and defers the
    // overflow to the inner scrollports.
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: to-rem($space-xl);
    flex: 1;

    @include layout-1024() {
      grid-template-columns: to-rem($space-7xl) minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: start;
    }
  }

  &-main {
    // Grid items default to min-width:auto — same min-content floor —
    // release it so the viewer can shrink to the track.
    min-width: 0;
  }

  // ── Treeview — collapsible panel under a toggle on mobile/tablet ─────
  &-nav-toggle {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    pointer-events: auto;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    text-align: left;
    color: inherit;
    border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-md);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
    user-select: text;

    &::before {
      content: '▸ ';
    }

    &[aria-expanded='true']::before {
      content: '▾ ';
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      outline: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
      outline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  &-nav {
    pointer-events: auto;
    display: none;
    max-height: 70vh;
    overflow: auto;
    // Translucent surface + blur — the fixed scene backdrop stays visible
    // around the edges without fighting the tree text for contrast.
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 92%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);

    .#{$_B_DOCS}-nav-open & {
      display: block;
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      display: block;
      position: sticky;
      top: to-rem($space-xl);
    }
  }

  &-tree {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);

    @include layout-960() {
      font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
    }

    li {
      position: relative;
    }

    // Nested levels draw the ASCII-tree shape: a vertical rail running the
    // whole branch (cut to the stub at the last sibling → `└─`) plus a
    // horizontal stub landing mid-row on each item.
    ul {
      list-style: none;
      padding-left: to-rem($space-md);
      margin: 0;

      li {
        &::before,
        &::after {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          left: -#{to-rem($space-sm)};
          background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 24%, transparent);
        }

        &::before {
          top: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          width: to-rem($space-hairline);
        }

        &::after {
          top: calc(#{to-rem($space-sm)} + 0.6em);
          width: to-rem($space-sm);
          height: to-rem($space-hairline);
        }

        &:last-child::before {
          bottom: auto;
          height: calc(#{to-rem($space-sm)} + 0.6em);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  &-tree-item {
    background: none;
    border: 0;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    text-align: left;
    // ≥34px row + side padding — a comfortable tap target on touch.
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-2xs);
    width: 100%;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    opacity: 0.85;
    user-select: text;

    // Disclosure triangle for dirs — border-drawn so no glyph literal is
    // needed; rotates when the branch is open.
    &[aria-expanded]::before {
      content: '';
      display: inline-block;
      width: 0;
      height: 0;
      margin-right: to-rem($space-2xs);
      border-top: to-rem($space-3xs) solid transparent;
      border-bottom: to-rem($space-3xs) solid transparent;
      border-left: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
      vertical-align: middle;
      transition: transform 0.15s ease;
    }

    &[aria-expanded='true']::before {
      transform: rotate(90deg);
    }

    &[aria-current='page'],
    &:focus-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      outline: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
      outline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    }
  }

  // ── Editable breadcrumbs ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-crumbs {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-md);
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-md);
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 88%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }

  &-crumb {
    pointer-events: auto;
    background: none;
    border: 0;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-2xs);
    opacity: 0.75;
    user-select: text;

    &::after {
      content: ' /';
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      outline: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    }
  }

  &-crumb-edit {
    pointer-events: auto;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: to-rem($space-4xl);
    background: transparent;
    border: to-rem($space-3xs) dashed currentColor;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    padding: to-rem($space-3xs) to-rem($space-2xs);
    opacity: 0.6;

    &:focus {
      opacity: 1;
      border-style: solid;
      outline: none;
    }
  }

  // ── Folder/file grid with generated glyphs ────────────────────────────
  &-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(to-rem($space-5xl), 1fr));
    gap: to-rem($space-md);
  }

  &-card {
    pointer-events: auto;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 90%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid transparent;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
    padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-sm);
    transition: border-color 0.4s ease;

    &:focus-visible,
    &:hover {
      border-color: currentColor;
      outline: none;
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      outline: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--focus-ring);
      outline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
    }
  }

  &-card-art {
    width: to-rem($space-4xl);
    height: to-rem($space-3xl);
    display: block;
  }

  &-card-label {
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    word-break: break-word;
    text-align: center;
  }

  // Generated folder glyph — strokes follow the theme ink.
  &-folder {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: visible;
  }

  &-folder-body {
    fill: none;
    stroke: currentColor;
    stroke-width: 1.5;
  }

  &-folder-thread {
    fill: none;
    stroke: currentColor;
    stroke-width: 0.6;
    opacity: 0.55;
  }

  // ── File viewer — translucent reading surface over the scene ─────────
  &-viewer {
    pointer-events: auto;
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
    padding: to-rem($space-md);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 93%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }

  &-viewer-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-sm);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
  }

  &-viewer-back {
    background: none;
    border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-md);
    cursor: pointer;
    min-height: to-rem($space-2xl);
  }

  &-viewer-path {
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    opacity: 0.7;
    word-break: break-all;
  }

  // ── Rendered content — markdown, JSON trees, sanitized html reports ──
  &-content {
    overflow: auto;
    max-width: 100%;

    // Generic element styling for markdown payloads — rendered html
    // reports (.docs-html) keep their own inlined styles instead.
    .docs-md {
      max-width: 75ch;
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);

      @include layout-960() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      h1,
      h2 {
        border-bottom: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xs);
        font-weight: 200;
      }

      h3,
      h4,
      h5,
      h6 {
        font-weight: 300;
      }

      a {
        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-underline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
      }

      code {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 0.9em;
        background: var(--bg-secondary);
        padding: to-rem($space-3xs) to-rem($space-2xs);
        border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
      }

      pre {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
        line-height: 1.5;
        padding: to-rem($space-md);
        overflow: auto;
        background: var(--bg-secondary);
        border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);

        code {
          background: none;
          padding: 0;
        }
      }

      table {
        border-collapse: collapse;
        width: 100%;
        font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
        display: block;
        overflow-x: auto;

        th,
        td {
          border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
          padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);
          text-align: left;
        }

        th {
          background: var(--bg-secondary);
        }

        tr:nth-child(even) td {
          background: var(--bg-secondary);
        }
      }

      blockquote {
        border-left: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        margin: to-rem($space-sm) 0;
        padding-left: to-rem($space-md);
        opacity: 0.8;
      }

      ul,
      ol {
        padding-left: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      hr {
        border: 0;
        border-top: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        opacity: 0.4;
        margin: to-rem($space-lg) 0;
      }

      img {
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
      }
    }

    // Sanitized html reports (istanbul coverage, generated docs): their
    // body/html selectors are remapped onto this wrapper at render time,
    // so it must supply the light paper surface those rules assume —
    // otherwise the report's dark text lands on the dark portal.
    .docs-html {
      max-width: none;
      padding: to-rem($space-md);
      background: var(--color-white-raw);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      color-scheme: light;
      overflow: auto;

      // Istanbul report regions are min-content wide (the 5-metric
      // summary table ~840px, code <pre> wider): give each its own
      // scrollport so the title, stat row, hints and filter stay
      // viewport-fit instead of pushing the whole pane sideways.
      table.coverage-summary,
      pre {
        display: block;
        overflow-x: auto;
        max-width: 100%;
        overscroll-behavior-inline: contain;
      }

      // Long file paths wrap inside their cell rather than widening it.
      table.coverage-summary td,
      table.coverage-summary td a {
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }

      // Mobile: the istanbul .pad1 chrome + our own padding both shrink so
      // the report's readable area keeps most of a narrow viewport.
      @media (max-width: $bk-768) {
        padding: to-rem($space-2xs);

        .pad1 {
          padding: to-rem($space-2xs);
        }
      }
    }

    // Parsed JSON surface — real numbers, key/field rows and tables.
    .docs-json {
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
      max-width: 75ch;

      @include layout-960() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      .docs-json-obj {
        margin: 0;
      }

      .docs-json-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(to-rem($space-6xl), auto) 1fr;
        gap: to-rem($space-md);
        padding: to-rem($space-3xs) 0;
        border-bottom: to-rem($space-3xs) dotted color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent);
        align-items: baseline;

        > dt {
          font-family: var(--font-mono);
          font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
          color: var(--text-secondary);
          overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        }

        > dd {
          margin: 0;
          min-width: 0;
          overflow-x: auto;
        }

        // Nested groups indent under their key.
        > dd .docs-json-obj,
        > dd .docs-json-table,
        > dd .docs-json-list {
          margin: to-rem($space-3xs) 0;
        }
      }

      .docs-json-num {
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        font-weight: 400;
      }

      .docs-json-str {
        color: var(--text-secondary);
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }

      .docs-json-bool,
      .docs-json-null {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        opacity: 0.8;
      }

      .docs-json-table {
        border-collapse: collapse;
        font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
        display: block;
        overflow-x: auto;

        th,
        td {
          border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
          padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);
          text-align: left;
          vertical-align: top;
        }

        th {
          background: var(--bg-secondary);
          font-family: var(--font-mono);
        }

        // Pivot tables (coverage-summary shape) — the outer key is the row
        // header; long file paths wrap instead of stretching the table.
        th[scope='row'] {
          font-weight: 400;
          color: var(--text-secondary);
          overflow-wrap: anywhere;
          max-width: 45ch;
        }
      }

      // Compact `key value` stat pairs inside pivot cells — a flat coverage
      // group (total/covered/skipped/pct) reads on one line, wrapping as a
      // block between pairs rather than mid-pair.
      .docs-json-kv {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
        margin-right: to-rem($space-sm);
        white-space: nowrap;

        &:last-child {
          margin-right: 0;
        }
      }

      .docs-json-k {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: to-rem($space-md);
        color: var(--text-secondary);
        opacity: 0.8;
      }

      // Meters shrink inside cells so a 4-column coverage table stays compact.
      .docs-json-kv .docs-json-pct-bar,
      .docs-json-table td .docs-json-pct-bar {
        width: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      .docs-json-list {
        margin: 0;
        padding-left: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      // Percentage meter — the coverage-summary "real numbers" treatment.
      .docs-json-pct {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }

      .docs-json-pct-bar {
        display: inline-block;
        width: to-rem($space-4xl);
        height: to-rem($space-sm);
        background: var(--bg-secondary);
        border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        vertical-align: middle;

        &::before {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          inset: 0;
          width: calc(var(--docs-json-pct) * 1%);
          background: currentColor;
          opacity: 0.7;
        }
      }

      .docs-json-nest,
      .docs-json-empty,
      .docs-json-more {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        opacity: 0.6;
      }

      .docs-json-link {
        color: inherit;
      }
    }

    // Mermaid diagrams — a themed surface; edge paths get a slow marching
    // dash so flowcharts read as living flows (the "fully animated"
    // contract), tuned subtle like the rest of the backdrop.
    .docs-mermaid {
      padding: to-rem($space-md);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
      overflow-x: auto;
      text-align: center;

      svg {
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
      }

      .edgePath path,
      .flowchart-link,
      .edgePaths .path {
        stroke-dasharray: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-2xs);
        animation: #{$_B_DOCS}-edge-flow 6s linear infinite;
      }

      .node rect,
      .node circle,
      .node polygon,
      .cluster rect {
        transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
      }
    }

    @keyframes #{$_B_DOCS}-edge-flow {
      to {
        stroke-dashoffset: to-rem($space-xl);
      }
    }

    // Readability surface for source/text payloads — the "ts files need a
    // background" contract: theme-aware --bg-secondary on --text-primary.
    .docs-code {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
      line-height: 1.5;
      padding: to-rem($space-md);
      overflow: auto;
      white-space: pre;
      tab-size: 2;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    }
  }

  // ── Architecture scene hidden state ──────────────────────────────────
  &-scene-off {
    display: none;
  }

  // ── Copy protection surface ───────────────────────────────────────────
  &-protected {
    user-select: none;
  }
}

// Mobile GPUs: backdrop blur is expensive — surfaces keep their
// near-opaque translucent bg and drop only the filter (app.scss contract).
@media (max-width: $bk-768) {
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-header,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-crumbs,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-nav,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-card,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-viewer {
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
    backdrop-filter: none;
  }
}

// Print-screen / print exfiltration: the protected region never prints.
@media print {
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-protected,
  .#{$_B_DOCS}-viewer {
    display: none;
  }
}
